verses.ar: «أَلَيْسَ جِهَادٌ لِلْإِنْسَانِ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَكَأَيَّامِ ٱلْأَجِيرِ أَيَّامُهُ؟
verses.kjv: [Is there] not an appointed time to man upon earth? [are not] his days also like the days of an hireling?
verses.web: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?

verses.ar: كَمَا يَتَشَوَّقُ ٱلْعَبْدُ إِلَى ٱلظِّلِّ، وَكَمَا يَتَرَجَّى ٱلْأَجِيرُ أُجْرَتَهُ،
verses.kjv: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for [the reward of] his work:
verses.web: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,

verses.ar: هَكَذَا تَعَيَّنَ لِي أَشْهُرُ سُوءٍ، وَلَيَالِي شَقَاءٍ قُسِمَتْ لِي.
verses.kjv: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.
verses.web: so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.

verses.ar: إِذَا ٱضْطَجَعْتُ أَقُولُ: مَتَى أَقُومُ؟ ٱللَّيْلُ يَطُولُ، وَأَشْبَعُ قَلَقًا حَتَّى ٱلصُّبْحِ.
verses.kjv: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.
verses.web: When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.

verses.ar: لَبِسَ لَحْمِيَ ٱلدُّودُ مَعَ مَدَرِ ٱلتُّرَابِ. جِلْدِي كَرِشَ وَسَاخَ.
verses.kjv: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.
verses.web: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.

verses.ar: أَيَّامِي أَسْرَعُ مِنَ ٱلْوَشِيعَةِ، وَتَنْتَهِي بِغَيْرِ رَجَاءٍ.
verses.kjv: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
verses.web: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

verses.ar: «اُذْكُرْ أَنَّ حَيَاتِي إِنَّمَا هِيَ رِيحٌ، وَعَيْنِي لَا تَعُودُ تَرَى خَيْرًا.
verses.kjv: O remember that my life [is] wind: mine eye shall no more see good.
verses.web: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.

verses.ar: لَا تَرَانِي عَيْنُ نَاظِرِي. عَيْنَاكَ عَلَيَّ وَلَسْتُ أَنَا.
verses.kjv: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no [more:] thine eyes [are] upon me, and I [am] not.
verses.web: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.

verses.ar: ٱلسَّحَابُ يَضْمَحِلُّ وَيَزُولُ، هَكَذَا ٱلَّذِي يَنْزِلُ إِلَى ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ لَا يَصْعَدُ.
verses.kjv: [As] the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no [more].
verses.web: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.

verses.ar: لَا يَرْجِعُ بَعْدُ إِلَى بَيْتِهِ، وَلَا يَعْرِفُهُ مَكَانُهُ بَعْدُ.
verses.kjv: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.
verses.web: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.

verses.ar: أَنَا أَيْضًا لَا أَمْنَعُ فَمِي. أَتَكَلَّمُ بِضِيقِ رُوحِي. أَشْكُو بِمَرَارَةِ نَفْسِي.
verses.kjv: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.web: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.ar: أَبَحْرٌ أَنَا أَمْ تِنِّينٌ، حَتَّى جَعَلْتَ عَلَيَّ حَارِسًا؟
verses.kjv: [Am] I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?
verses.web: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?

verses.ar: إِنْ قُلْتُ: فِرَاشِي يُعَزِّينِي، مَضْجَعِي يَنْزِعُ كُرْبَتِي،
verses.kjv: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;
verses.web: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,’

verses.ar: تُرِيعُنِي بِٱلْأَحْلَامِ، وَتُرْهِبُنِي بِرُؤًى،
verses.kjv: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:
verses.web: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,

verses.ar: فَٱخْتَارَتْ نَفْسِي ٱلْخَنِقَ، ٱلْمَوْتَ عَلَى عِظَامِي هَذِهِ.
verses.kjv: So that my soul chooseth strangling, [and] death rather than my life.
verses.web: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.

verses.ar: قَدْ ذُبْتُ. لَا إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ أَحْيَا. كُفَّ عَنِّي لِأَنَّ أَيَّامِي نَفْخَةٌ.
verses.kjv: I loathe [it;] I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days [are] vanity.
verses.web: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.

verses.ar: مَا هُوَ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ حَتَّى تَعْتَبِرَهُ، وَحَتَّى تَضَعَ عَلَيْهِ قَلْبَكَ؟
verses.kjv: What [is] man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?
verses.web: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,

verses.ar: وَتَتَعَهَّدَهُ كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ، وَكُلَّ لَحْظَةٍ تَمْتَحِنَهُ؟
verses.kjv: And [that] thou shouldest visit him every morning, [and] try him every moment?
verses.web: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?

verses.ar: حَتَّى مَتَى لَا تَلْتَفِتُ عَنِّي وَلَا تُرْخِينِي رَيْثَمَا أَبْلَعُ رِيقِي؟
verses.kjv: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
verses.web: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?

verses.ar: أَأَخْطَأْتُ؟ مَاذَا أَفْعَلُ لَكَ يَا رَقِيبَ ٱلنَّاسِ؟ لِمَاذَا جَعَلْتَنِي عَاثُورًا لِنَفْسِكَ حَتَّى أَكُونَ عَلَى نَفْسِي حِمْلًا؟
verses.kjv: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?
verses.web: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?

verses.ar: وَلِمَاذَا لَا تَغْفِرُ ذَنْبِي، وَلَا تُزِيلُ إِثْمِي؟ لِأَنِّي ٱلْآنَ أَضْطَجِعُ فِي ٱلتُّرَابِ، تَطْلُبُنِي فَلَا أَكُونُ».
verses.kjv: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I [shall] not [be].
verses.web: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”
